text: Assess how popular Mussolini’s policies were with the Italian people in the years 1925 to 1941.
‘Stalin’s economic policies brought few benefits to the workers and peasants in the Soviet Union.’
Discuss this view. [30]
Assess how far increasing support for the Nazi Party in the years 1929 to 1932 was the result of
skilful propaganda. [30]
‘Recovery from the Great Depression in Britain was the result of government economic policies.’
Discuss this view. [30]
Section B: The history of the USA, 1944–92
‘A defeat for the Republican Party rather than a victory for Truman and his policies.’ Assess this
view of the presidential election of 1948. [30]
‘The growth of feminism in the 1960s and 1970s was mostly the result of the work of women’s
organisations.’ Evaluate this view. [30]
‘The Iran–Contra Affair was deeply damaging to Reagan and the Republican Party.’ Discuss this
view. [30]
Assess how successfully the US managed its relations with the USSR in the period 1950–63. [30]
Section C: International history, 1945–92
‘Soviet suppression of the 1956 uprising in Hungary had limited impact on US–Soviet relations.’
Assess this view. [30]
‘The Korean War was caused by Stalin’s ambition to strengthen Soviet influence in Asia.’ Assess
this view. [30]
Evaluate how far the UN was responsible for its failure in Somalia. [30]
Assess how far the creation of the state of Israel in 1948 was the result of US involvement. [30]
